answer: The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures. Each submission hangs on the echo of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the yarrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
